title: Common-exponent comparison of normalized orientations
statement: Let A be any finite commutative ring killed by ell^n for a prime ell and n>=1. Let f:X->Y be a separated smooth quasi-compact compactified morphism of Noetherian schemes, of pure relative dimension d. Supply its smooth diagonal geometry G, invertibility of every positive ell-power on X, and an ordinary dualizing orientation alpha satisfying OrientationNormalized at ell^n, all as in [def-sp-general-ring-canonical-data]. For every n'>=1 also annihilating A, the common maximum power annihilates A and has the two Kummer power maps with generator-normalized Tate-line isomorphisms b and b'. There exists an orientation alpha' normalized at ell^n' for the same G, with alpha.hom followed by the inverse common-level line map equal to alpha'.hom followed by the other inverse line map. This compares orientations only, without asserting the tensor formula or equality of purity maps.

proof.text: The Mathlib divisibility pow_dvd_pow at n <= max(n,n prime), followed by the characteristic-divisibility criterion, proves that the common maximum power annihilates A. Apply the exponent clause of etaleFiniteTwistPullback separately at n and n prime to construct q,q prime and the degree-one isomorphisms b,b prime. Their power and generator laws are exactly FiniteGeneralRingKummerComparison.

Let e and e prime be finiteGeneralRingLevelPower of b and b prime. Construct alpha prime as alpha followed by e inverse and e prime. Destructure the given OrientationNormalized witness into kappa, its normalization, the cone/bundle square sq, and the orientation equation. Reuse these same kappa and sq. Apply the private bundle_exponent, proved by transposing lem-sp-general-ring-integration-exponent and applying zero-section pullback naturality to e and e prime on the diagonal conormal bundle. Both e followed by the old bundle-section adjunct and e prime followed by the new adjunct equal the common-level adjunct. Substituting these equalities and cancelling e inverse followed by e proves the normalization equation for alpha prime. Finally cancel e prime followed by its inverse to get the requested equality in the common-maximum line.

theorem finiteGeneralRingExponent
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (ell n : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime] (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hA : ((ell ^ n : ℕ) : A) = 0)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    [HasCompactification f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    (geometry : Etale.FiniteRingSectionDeformation.Geometry d
      (pullback.fst f f) (pullback.diagonal f))
    (hUnits : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → IsUnit ((ell ^ m : ℕ) : Γ(X, ⊤)))
    (alpha : Etale.dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f ≅
      Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.line A (ell ^ n) hA X d)
    (halpha : Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.OrientationNormalized A (ell ^ n)
      (pow_pos (Fact.out : ell.Prime).pos n) hA f d geometry (hUnits n hn) alpha) :
  ∀ (n' : ℕ) (hn' : 1 ≤ n') (hA' : ((ell ^ n' : ℕ) : A) = 0),
    ∃ hM : ((ell ^ max n n' : ℕ) : A) = 0,
    ∃ (q : X.rootsOfUnitySheaf (ell ^ max n n') ⟶ X.rootsOfUnitySheaf (ell ^ n))
      (q' : X.rootsOfUnitySheaf (ell ^ max n n') ⟶ X.rootsOfUnitySheaf (ell ^ n'))
      (b : Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine X (ell ^ max n n') A hM ≅
        Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine X (ell ^ n) A hA)
      (b' : Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine X (ell ^ max n n') A hM ≅
        Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine X (ell ^ n') A hA')
      (alpha' : Etale.dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f ≅
        Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.line A (ell ^ n') hA' X d),
      FiniteGeneralRingKummerComparison A _ _ hM hA X q b ∧
      FiniteGeneralRingKummerComparison A _ _ hM hA' X q' b' ∧
      Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.OrientationNormalized A (ell ^ n')
        (pow_pos (Fact.out : ell.Prime).pos n') hA' f d geometry (hUnits n' hn') alpha' ∧
      alpha.hom ≫ (finiteGeneralRingLevelPower A _ _ hM hA X b d).inv =
        alpha'.hom ≫ (finiteGeneralRingLevelPower A _ _ hM hA' X b' d).inv
